entries.text: 惊涛海味料理人海岱！\n前来为你上菜！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_first_01

entries.text: 你身为学生却还负责\n邀请特邀教员对吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_01

entries.text: 真是个厉害得\n不得了的孩子呀！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_02

entries.text: 是呀！
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 你过奖了……
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 啊、哈、哈！你那份\n敢于肯定自我的自信！\r\n真是爆护！爆护！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_03

entries.text: 啊、哈、哈！称赞厉害的人\n可是理所当然的事！\r\n你谦虚也不会有好处哦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_03b

entries.text: 真的很感谢\n你给俺远征的机会！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_04

entries.text: 俺也要和学生们\n共同成长～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_05

entries.text: 这里四面环海，\n环境得天独厚！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_00

entries.text: 俺和宝可梦们都很兴奋\n能感受到海风！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_01

entries.text: 然而这里的食堂，\n菜单里竟然没有海鲜……[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_02

entries.text: 如果能用附近海里的\n新鲜食材做饭吃到饱……\r\n相信学生们会很高兴吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_03

entries.text: 会高兴的！
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 现在这样也不错……
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 收到你的保证了！\n男子汉海岱！要大显厨艺！！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_04

entries.text: 虽然偶尔吃些快餐也不错，\n但每天吃可是会营养失衡的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_04b

entries.text: 学生们，等着吧！\n稚鱼团团游动的渔场是食堂！\r\n海岱俱乐部开始营业！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_05

entries.text: 哦哦！俺告诉你件事，\n保证让你惊掉下巴！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_00

entries.text: 蓝莓学园的学生食堂\n要和海岱俱乐部……\r\n联手合作了！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_01

entries.text: 好厉害！
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 太让人期待了！
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 因为是刚刚才定下来的，\n所以距离正式开始还需要一些时间～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_02

entries.text: 首先俺要把\n海岱俱乐部的名菜佛跳墙\r\n面向学生改良！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_03

entries.text: 因为俺想让正处于\n发育时期的孩子们吃上好东西！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_04

entries.text: ……俺只是做了这辈子想做的事，\n结果和食品教育的事挂上钩了！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_05

entries.text: 托你邀请俺来学园的福，\n俺也学到东西了，收获爆护！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_00

entries.text: 啊、哈、哈！\n这可得感谢你啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_01

entries.text: 你要顺着这个发展\n和俺进行宝可梦交换吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_02

entries.text:
是[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊，真够生猛！
爆护！爆护！\c
俺会亲手
培育它成长的～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_04

entries.text: 你要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和俺的轻身鳕交换吗？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_03

entries.text:
宝可梦只有１只的话，
是无法用来交换的！\c
同行宝可梦最好
有２只以上哦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_03_00

entries.text: 果然你还是想\n和俺交换宝可梦吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_04_00

entries.text: 嘿！吃了吗？\c\n你要和叔叔俺\n来一场生猛的对战吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_talkto_00

entries.text: 钓到大家伙了！\n那么俺们走吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 58]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 你势不可挡！\n犹如鲤鱼王的攀瀑！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 受到年轻人的刺激，\n叔叔俺也能够成长哦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 收下这个和你一样\n热腾腾的东西吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 欢迎你随时再度光临！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 58]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 吁、吁～！？\n又被你赢下一城！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 男子汉海岱！\n期待你再次来战！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 千变万化的惊涛海岱的实力！\n还远不是你能看透的吧！\r\n啊、哈、哈、哈！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 蓝莓学园的颜色真棒！\n和玻瓶市的蓝色相似。\r\n多么透彻的蓝色啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 在生态巨蛋中\n坚强绽放的花儿！\r\n多么宝贵的存在呀……！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
近距离观察学生
能够学到很多不同的东西！\c
全新的上相姿势
爆护啦！爆护啦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你交换给俺的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n可生猛活泼了！\r\n它是只有前途的宝可梦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
俺放出的轻身鳕
那可是锋锐无比！\c
它偶尔会舍身一搏，
你可别被吓着哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
啊、哈、哈！
俺从也慈小姐那听说了！\c
你把俺男子汉海岱
选为你最喜欢的
道馆馆主了吧！\c
叔叔俺开心得
干劲就像洪流一样！\c
因为俺也一直
都很重视你啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_sp
